240-574-5470-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-5470-7297.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

783-2645-3430-5475.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
783-2645-3430-5475.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1263-4871-5332-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4871-5332-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Carmen and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4875-5231-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4875-5231-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

140-1170-8164.easyPrerequisites:
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
Heartwood Crafter is prepared.
140-1170-8164.notablePrerequisites: You've lost 2 or more life this turn.
140-1170-8164.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat from step 2

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3384-4550-5567-8095--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3384-4550-5567-8095--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4247-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4247-7399.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

997-2301-2738-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Abzan Ascendancy, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1887-2122-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Vorinclex
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

3457-7066-7791.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Avatar Kyoshi.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat.

1169-1445-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1169-1445-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4644-5223-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1746-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

339-677-1115-5147.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

413-2178-3817-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
413-2178-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

2468-2575.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Temporal Mastery without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Mastery, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1379-1580-1913-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {1}.
Repeat.

725-2034-5969-5970.notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
725-2034-5969-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping a Devil, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Devil, adding {C}{C}.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping a Devil, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1636-5968-5970--64.notablePrerequisites:
The Room has one half locked, and the other half unlocked.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to unlock the locked Room.
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5968-5970--64.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to unlock a locked Room you control.
Unlock any Room you control by paying its mana cost.
Ghostly Dancers' second ability triggers, creating a 3/1 Spirit creature token. 
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untap all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking the Room that was unlocked in step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5223-5500.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-5500.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2757-4875-5463.notablePrerequisites:
Any creature type except "Faerie" chosen with Conspiracy.
You control at least one basic Plains.
2757-4875-5463.description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Nurturing Pixie by paying {W}.
When Nurturing Pixie enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Nurturing Pixie, untapping the Plains.
Resolve the Nurturing Pixie trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield, as it is not a Faerie due to Conspiracy.
Repeat.

887-1360-2390.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a counter on a permanent and/or player.
887-1360-2390.description:
Put a counter on a permanent and/or player.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing that much damage to an opponent.
Virtue of Courage triggers, causing you to exile that many cards from the top of your library.
Laelia's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 2.

1870-3190-3316.notablePrerequisites: The number of charge counters on Eternity Vessel plus the number of charge counters on Dragonspark Reactor is greater than or equal to an opponent's life total.
1870-3190-3316.description:
Cast Dismantle by paying {2}{R}, destroying Eternity Vessel, and putting a number of charge counters on Dragonspark Reactor equal to the number Eternity Vessel had.
Activate Dragonspark Reactor by paying {4} and sacrificing it, dealing damage equal to the number of charge counters on it to an opponent and up to one target creature.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

409-4211-4377.description:
Activate Tormod's Crpyt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Deadbridge Chant triggers, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can fail if other cards enter your graveyard after step 1.

905-2178-4386.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Disciple of Tevesh Szat.
Disciple of Tevesh Szat does not have summoning sickness.
905-2178-4386.description:
Activate Disciple of Tevesh Szat's first ability by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Disciple of Tevesh Szat triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

176-2034-2837.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other non-Spirit you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Requiem Angel, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token.
Repeat.

225-280-539-2248.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Skyshroud Ranger as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

2173-4899-4996.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 6 or higher.
2173-4899-4996.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have an empty library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality from the top of your library by paying 6 life, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Repeat step 4.
